family: L is the language of all finite bit strings of odd Hamming weight. For every n>=0 and every x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x)=x_1 XOR ... XOR x_n, with f_0=0. The uniform deterministic evaluator scans the actual n bits; its NP verifier accepts only the empty witness and iff the scan parity is 1.
theorem: For every integer n>=1, the minimum number C_B2(f_n) of retained gates in an exact deterministic acyclic one-output circuit with two input pins per gate, all 16 binary Boolean tables and unrestricted sharing is exactly n-1. Consequently C_B2(f_n)>=n-1 at every n>=1, and liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/n=1.
